newsitem.title: UK: UK's Major says junior ministers "unwise" over EMU.
newsitem.headline: UK's Major says junior ministers "unwise" over EMU.

text.p: British Prime Minister John Major said two junior ministers had been "very unwise" to make comments contradicting government policy over whether to enter a single European currency.

Major told a news conference that there should be no doubt that the government was bound by collective responsibility. Conservative party wounds over Europe were reopened when junior health minister John Horam and junior education minister James Paice made it clear they opposed the idea of a single currency.
"I think those two ministers were very unwise. I think they both understand that and that they will tell you that. There is no doubt about collective cabinet responsibility," Major said.
"Those people have expressed what their instincts are but they don't know what I am going to negotiate."
